narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Heavy Bronze Mace, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Whoa. You came well prepared! Hope that mace is for me, unless you plan to do ALL of the fighting.
narrative.requestItemsText: Shh. Keep your voice down. I'm not ready for a fight, yet.
